description: ライン全景（センサと反射板がボトル下部の高さで向かい合う）
prompt: Photorealistic wide shot. A long straight stainless-steel conveyor runs from the left background toward the right foreground, carrying a steady row of upright transparent 500 ml PET bottles filled with water, white caps, no labels. No people. Sensor layout (must follow exactly): on ONE side of the conveyor, a small plain dark-gray rectangular photoelectric sensor (matchbox size, one round lens on its front face, cable out of the back, no logo, no text) on a short stainless bracket points horizontally ACROSS the conveyor. Directly opposite on the OTHER side, at exactly the same height and facing the sensor, is a small square gray prismatic retroreflector plate (about 5 cm square, no text) on its own bracket. Both are low, at the height of the LOWER part of the bottles (about one fifth of the bottle height above the belt), never at the shoulder or cap. No visible light beams, no lasers. No text, no logos, no signs, no labels, no name tags, no badges anywhere. Clean, bright Japanese beverage bottling factory, stainless steel, bright white ceiling lights, pale blue-gray tones, high-end corporate photography, 16:9, 2K.
